messages.subject: "print" command not leaving space between columns
parts:
Hi,

Is this a known issue with the "print" command, not leaving space
between columns? I'm using 1.3.0. In the following the sd and all the
percentiles are smooshed together:

% ~/dev/stan/stan/bin/print samples.csv | head

1 chains: each with iter=(1000); warmup=(0); thin=(1); 1000 iterations saved.

Dan

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: "print" command not leaving space between columns
parts:
Yeah, there are several known issues with the print command involving spacing and precision of small numbers that have been fixed and should be included in the next release of Stan.

Ben
